checklist.question: Does the protocol serve existing O/RQ/I/claims without creating a new research mainline or changing Scheme B?
Are the design tag, commit, frozen assets, KG identity and post-freeze version boundary bound precisely?
Are component responsibilities, inputs, outputs, failures and dependencies complete without reusing incompatible legacy benchmark models?
Does the protocol enforce development-only generation and exclude confirmation, E2E, Provider, judge and formal result creation?
Are crosswalk, relation, oracle/veto and view leakage failures fail-closed and attributable?
Are write-new storage, checkpoints, resume hash binding, tamper handling and rollback rules sufficient?
Do P0-P7 gates and evidence distinguish offline implementation validation from benchmark effects, production capability and formal evidence?

instructions: A user or independent reviewer must decide every item and the overall decision. Automatic audit must not author, infer or approve human decisions.
